summary.text: Jumpstart 2022 gathers short stories from many planes, among them Kamigawa, where Michiko Konda leaves home vowing not to return until she can restore her father and the peace of her plane.
On Ravnica, the trapped demon Ob Nixilis commits random acts of torment, while Ugin tells Jace Beleren that the Eldrazi can be imprisoned by hedrons, and Jace is skeptical.
Elsewhere, Odric realizes Skirsdag infiltrators have compromised the church, and Kastinne follows her children's tormentors into caves below Stensia.
